evals.prompt: The feature is finished in this dirty feature-branch worktree. Ship it and open a pull request. There are also unrelated local notes in the worktree that must not be included.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the intended files, stages only those files, commits, pushes the feature branch, creates or updates a PR, reads it back, and reports the complete handoff while preserving unrelated changes.
expectations: The agent inspects status, diffs, branch, remotes, and the refreshed remote default before changing Git state.
The skill does not run application tests, builds, linters, formatters, renderers, or content-validation commands.
Only task-related paths are staged; unrelated dirty and untracked files remain untouched.
The intended changes are committed and the non-default branch is pushed without force.
An open PR is created or updated and then read back for checks, review state, and conflicts.
The final report includes the commit, PR URL, readiness, checks, review state, conflicts, and residual risk.

evals.prompt: Everything is committed locally, but I have not pushed this branch yet. Please ship it as a PR.
evals.expected_output: The existing commit is pushed without creating an empty commit, then a PR is created or updated and verified.
expectations: The agent recognizes that no new commit is needed and does not create an empty commit.
The local commit is pushed with an upstream when needed, and confirmed on the remote branch.
The agent creates or updates exactly one PR for the qualified head branch.
The PR is read back and its status is reported.

evals.prompt: I pushed the branch already and there is an open PR. Finish shipping the latest work.
evals.expected_output: The agent confirms that the remote contains the local tip, finds the existing PR, updates stale title/body details if needed, and reports its current status without making a duplicate PR.
expectations: No unnecessary commit or push is performed when the remote already contains the local tip.
The existing PR is selected using the destination repository and qualified head branch.
The final branch diff and PR description agree.
No duplicate PR is created and the existing PR is read back before reporting.

evals.prompt: These finished changes are currently on main. Ship them for review without pushing directly to main.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the work, moves delivery to an appropriate dedicated feature branch under repository policy, commits, pushes that branch, and opens a PR to the intended base.
expectations: The agent does not commit or push directly to the default branch.
A dedicated feature branch is used without discarding the existing work.
Scoped staging, commit, push, PR creation or update, and PR read-back all occur.
The PR base is the intended default branch and the head is the feature branch.

evals.prompt: Ship this branch. The remote rejects the push as non-fast-forward.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches and diagnoses the branch relationship, preserves all work, avoids force-push or history rewriting, and reports a concrete blocker without falsely claiming delivery.
expectations: The rejected push is investigated using refreshed remote state.
No force-push, reset, rebase, stash, or destructive cleanup is performed without authorization.
A PR is not claimed as fully delivered when its remote head lacks the intended commit.
The final response states the exact branch relationship and blocker.

evals.prompt: Commit the completed work, but do not push it or create a pull request yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent stages and commits only the intended work, honors the explicit delivery boundary, and accurately reports that push and PR creation were intentionally skipped.
expectations: The agent stages only intended files before committing.
No push or PR mutation is attempted.
The final response does not describe the branch as fully shipped and clearly identifies the user-requested boundary.

evals.prompt: Ship the task changes. Some unrelated edits are already staged, and one modified file contains both task-related and unrelated hunks.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves unrelated working-tree content, unstages unrelated pre-staged changes, selectively stages only intended hunks, then commits, pushes, and creates or updates the PR.
expectations: Unrelated pre-staged changes are removed from the index without altering working-tree content.
Mixed files are staged selectively by hunk rather than added wholesale.
The exact staged patch is inspected before committing and contains only intended changes.
Unrelated changes remain present and uncommitted after the complete delivery workflow.

evals.prompt: Ship this fork branch to a PR against the upstream repository. The checkout has both origin (my fork) and upstream remotes.
evals.expected_output: The agent pushes to the selected fork remote, derives the PR destination from the upstream base remote and the qualified head from the fork remote, then creates or updates the PR in the upstream repository.
expectations: The base repository is explicitly derived from the upstream remote rather than inferred from the working directory.
The head owner and repository are explicitly derived from the remote receiving the push.
The pushed branch is verified to match the qualified head_ref.
All gh PR commands use the explicit upstream destination repository and do not target the fork accidentally.
